info.title: Chleb Bible Search
info.description: Query the bible, or get a verse of the day.

detail.example: Request rate exceeded for this session

message.description: a message whose content doesn't really matter

book.description: Book in which this verse appears

emotion.description: Primary emotional sentiment of the verse

items.description: Additional sentiment(s) detected for the verse

text.description: Verbatim and unedited text from the Holy Bible.
text.example: Thus did Noah; according to all that God commanded him, so did he.

chapter.description: Chapter number in which verse appears

sample_verse_text.example: The gates of the rivers shall be opened, and the palace shall be dissolved.

sample_verse_chapter_ordinal.description: Which chapter the sample verse (sample_verse_text) came from

sample_verse_ordinal_in_chapter.description: The sample_verse_text verse number within a the chapter (sample_verse_chapter_ordinal).

book_count.description: How many unique books available to query, across all translations, ie. could be more than 66 depending on translations loaded

items.description: The short name of the book, which is used in all REST-related queries
The short name of the book, which is used for logging, backend lookups in the database, verse attributions
The full name of the book, arbitary length

translation_count.description: How many translations are immediately available, includes core and plugin translations

items.description: Translations immediately available such as 'asv', 'kjv', and any additional translations loaded dynamically into the server, the reserved words 'any' and 'all' are not listed but are always available.

build_time.description: Build timestamp captured when this build was created

admin_email.description: Email address to contact the server administrator

changeset.description: Git changeset captured when this build was created

version.description: Version string in opaque, non-processable format

build_os.description: Operating system where this build was created

build_host.description: Hostname where this build was created

perl_version.description: Perl version used when this build was created

build_arch.description: Architecture where this build was created

included.description: Related resources included in the document

msec.description: ms for core request resolution, without overhead, for debugging core algorithm degradation and loading only

Translation.description: Translation code, or the reserved value "all". Additional translation codes may be installed dynamically.

yesterday.description: URL for the previous verse of the day

self.description: URL for the current page of search results

next.description: URL for the next page of search results, omitted on the last page

last.description: URL for the last page of search results

tomorrow.description: URL for the following verse of the day

prev.description: URL for the previous page of search results, omitted on the first page

first.description: URL for the first page of search results

text.description: Description of uptime in human-readable text

total_count.description: Total number of results considered after applying the search limit

per_page.description: Number of results requested per page after normalisation

count.description: Number of results returned on this page

total_pages.description: Total number of pages available for the current search

TestHttpError.description: Deliberate registered HTTP error response. Status-specific protocol headers are included where applicable.

Retry-After.description: Number of seconds the client should wait before retrying.

Please use the /1/lookup/{book}/{chapter}/{verse} route where possible, all parameters supported there, are implicitly supported here, but if you use this route, you will encounter and need to handle a redirect (307).

get.description: Search for criteria in the whole bible. Ordinary searches may also match translation-specific thesaurus terms, so equivalent wording used by a selected translation can be found. Set `wholeword` to true to require an exact whole-word match without thesaurus expansion.
